archivos.contenido_completo:
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "sqlite"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

model Course {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  name        String
  description String?
  status      String   @default("CREATED")
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt

  materials         Material[]
  generationJobs    GenerationJob[]
  sessions          Session[]
  finalExam         FinalExam?
  quizAttempts      QuizAttempt[]
  finalExamAttempts FinalExamAttempt[]
}

model Material {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId    String
  name        String
  storagePath String
  type        String
  sizeBytes   Int
  uploadedAt  DateTime @default(now())

  course Course @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([courseId])
}

model GenerationJob {
  id            String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId      String
  status        String   @default("PENDING")
  progress      Int      @default(0)
  currentStepIndex Int?
  errorMessage  String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt

  course Course @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([courseId, createdAt])
}

model Session {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId          String
  sequenceOrder     Int
  title             String
  learningObjective String
  durationMinutes   Int
  xpReward          Int      @default(50)
  isUnlocked        Boolean  @default(false)
  introTitle        String
  introContent      String
  introKeyTakeaway  String
  introCodeSnippet  String?
  guidedPractice    String
  challenge         String
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now())

  course   Course    @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  concepts Concept[]
  quiz     Quiz?

  @@unique([courseId, sequenceOrder])
}

model Concept {
  id        String   @id @default(uuid())
  sessionId String
  name      String
  summary   String
  detail    String
  example   String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  session            Session             @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  quizQuestions      QuizQuestion[]
  finalExamQuestions FinalExamQuestion[]

  @@index([sessionId])
}

model Quiz {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid())
  sessionId        String   @unique
  passingThreshold Int
  xpReward         Int      @default(100)
  createdAt        DateTime @default(now())

  session      Session        @relation(fields: [sessionId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  questions    QuizQuestion[]
  quizAttempts QuizAttempt[]
}

model QuizQuestion {
  id             String   @id @default(uuid())
  quizId         String
  conceptId      String
  prompt         String
  context        String?
  optionsPayload String
  explanation    String
  createdAt      DateTime @default(now())

  quiz           Quiz                @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  concept        Concept             @relation(fields: [conceptId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  attemptAnswers QuizAttemptAnswer[]

  @@index([quizId])
}

model QuizAttempt {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId         String
  quizId           String?
  attemptNumber    Int
  totalQuestions   Int
  correctAnswers   Int
  incorrectAnswers Int
  scorePercent     Int
  isPassed         Boolean
  submittedAt      DateTime @default(now())

  course  Course              @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  quiz    Quiz?               @relation(fields: [quizId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  answers QuizAttemptAnswer[]

  @@index([courseId, submittedAt])
  @@index([quizId, submittedAt])
}

model QuizAttemptAnswer {
  id                  String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId           String
  questionId          String?
  questionSnapshot    String
  conceptSnapshot     String
  selectedOptionId    String?
  selectedOptionText  String?
  isCorrect           Boolean
  correctOptionId     String
  correctOptionText   String
  explanationSnapshot String
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())

  attempt  QuizAttempt   @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question QuizQuestion? @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([attemptId])
}

model FinalExam {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId         String   @unique
  passingScorePct  Int       @default(70)
  estimatedMinutes Int
  cooldownUntil    DateTime?
  createdAt        DateTime  @default(now())

  course    Course              @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  questions FinalExamQuestion[]
  attempts  FinalExamAttempt[]
}

model FinalExamQuestion {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  examId      String
  conceptId   String
  type        String
  prompt      String
  context     String?
  payload     String
  explanation String
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  exam           FinalExam                @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  concept        Concept                  @relation(fields: [conceptId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  attemptAnswers FinalExamAttemptAnswer[]

  @@index([examId])
}

model FinalExamAttempt {
  id               String   @id @default(uuid())
  courseId         String
  examId           String?
  attemptNumber    Int
  totalQuestions   Int
  correctAnswers   Int
  incorrectAnswers Int
  scorePercent     Int
  isPassed         Boolean
  submittedAt      DateTime @default(now())

  course  Course                   @relation(fields: [courseId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  exam    FinalExam?               @relation(fields: [examId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  answers FinalExamAttemptAnswer[]

  @@index([courseId, submittedAt])
  @@index([examId, submittedAt])
}

model FinalExamAttemptAnswer {
  id                  String   @id @default(uuid())
  attemptId           String
  questionId          String?
  type                String
  questionSnapshot    String
  studentPayload      String?
  evalPayload         String
  isCorrect           Boolean
  explanationSnapshot String
  createdAt           DateTime @default(now())

  attempt  FinalExamAttempt   @relation(fields: [attemptId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  question FinalExamQuestion? @relation(fields: [questionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([attemptId])
}
